Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. Design a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. Prefer spacing, grouping, alignment and typography first, then simple separators, subtle surface tint, light borders and restrained elevation. No cards inside cards, no giant enclosing app-card. Readable simplified Chinese typography, 14–16px body, no more than two fonts.
Product: 新境 / XINJING, Chinese Windows desktop game toolbox. User wants the 系统 / 硬件 page as an extension of the existing app, precisely consistent with its homepage. The screen should help players understand PC hardware and current resource load.
Target dimensions 1487 x 1058 landscape, matching attached references; one complete app screen, no browser chrome, physical monitor, phone bezel, numbered option label, collage or presentation surround. Never stretch imagery or type to fit; use the natural aspect ratio.
Attached image A is the approved homepage design, image B is the current implemented game library. Both are STYLE REFERENCES, preserve recognizable identical shell: airy pale sky-blue anime fantasy landscape with white floating stone citadels, waterfalls, foliage and water; mint #a5f2df accent, white frosted glass, fine white borders, navy-black text, slate-blue secondary text, MiSans-like Chinese type, same 12–24px corner radii and soft shadows. Content surfaces must be opaque enough for legibility over wallpaper. Retain background scene, not a new technical sci-fi or dark dashboard theme. No neon, purple cyberpunk, bright gradients, glowing hardware images or thick outlines.
Preserve dock x17 y26 w92 h653 with existing angular mint mountain 新境/XINJING brand and six items 首页, 游戏库, 硬件, 工具, 优化, 音乐. Select 硬件 mint, other entries neutral. Same top global search x208 y27 w424 h47 label 搜索游戏、工具或功能... with Ctrl K. Same avatar, appearance, minimize/maximize/close controls top right. Use Font Awesome-style icons, not emoji. Main title 系统与硬件, short subtitle 了解你的设备，掌握运行状态. Top navigation tabs 总览 / 设备信息 / 实时监测 according to chosen direction. Show a small quiet 演示数据 badge near title; all visible readings and specifications are design examples, not detected from the user's PC. Current date anchor 2026-10-24 Saturday Asia/Shanghai, if displayed use 2026年10月24日 星期六. Trends represent 最近60秒 ending 现在, plausible low desktop load; do not invent real gaming performance. No promotional gaming optimization claims, fake online stats, warning banners or universal 健康100% badge.
Consistent demo device data across directions: CPU AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D, 8核心16线程, usage18%, temperature48°C, frequency4.2GHz, power35W. GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER, usage12%, temperature42°C, VRAM1.2/12GB. Memory16GB DDR5, used7.6/16GB =47.5%, optionally rounded48%, 6000MT/s. Motherboard MSI B650M MORTAR WIFI. Never invent game FPS: if shown use 当前未检测到游戏 or —. Unavailable metrics use —, not zero. No serial numbers, IPs, credentials or implementation technology labels.
Focus action appropriate to page: 导出报告, with secondary 传感器详情, or monitoring pause in monitor direction. Keep only relevant actions. Expose 设备信息 and 实时监测 through modest tabs rather than every feature on screen. No game cover cards, homepage greeting, announcements, enhancement switches or device-pairing widgets on hardware page. No new routes or additional unrelated dock items. Clear information hierarchy and generous whitespace; no tiny dense technical labels, all content fully visible and aligned. No watermark.
